children: The euro is expected to weaken further against the dollar in 2027 due to weak growth in the eurozone and political uncertainty in France, BCA Research's Mathieu Savary and Jeremie Peloso say in a note. The growth and political challenges in the region are likely to add risk premia on European assets and limit the European Central Bank's ability to raise interest rates, the strategists say. These would weigh on the euro versus dollar for a least six months and possibly longer, they say. "We think EUR/USD will only find a durable floor near $1.05." The euro falls 0.2% against dollar to $1.0945. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
